Invoice basics

Everything a new business owner should know before creating an invoice

What is an online invoice maker?

An online invoice maker is a browser-based tool that helps you create invoices with business details, customer details, line items, tax, totals and payment terms.

Who should use it?

Freelancers, consultants, contractors, agencies, small shops and GST businesses use online invoice makers to bill customers quickly and keep cleaner records.

Why PDF invoices matter

PDF invoices keep layout consistent across phones, laptops, email and WhatsApp. They look more professional than screenshots or manually edited files.

Invoice format India

A practical Indian invoice includes seller details, buyer details, invoice number, issue date, due date, line items, taxable value, tax, total, notes and terms.

Practical tips

Invoice details that help clients pay faster

Use clear invoice numbers like INV-001, INV-002 or FY26-001.
Add payment terms such as due within 7 days, due on receipt or due by a specific date.
Mention GSTIN when you are GST registered and your customer needs a tax invoice.
Write service descriptions clearly so clients understand exactly what they are paying for.
Share PDF invoices to avoid formatting issues on WhatsApp, email or mobile.
Save repeat client details after signup so future invoices take less time.

How it works

1
